contradicting_evidence: Positive BTC and ETH daily returns and 66% advancing breadth demonstrate that a rebound is already possible despite adverse slower flows.
The small-alt proxy had approximately 71% advancers and a positive median return. Participation is therefore not uniformly weak, although coverage is limited.
Funding at the live anchor was modestly positive, and hourly open-interest declines were small; an acute leverage-driven breakdown is not established.
The ETF observation is one settled session, and stablecoin supply contraction does not prove equivalent selling pressure in crypto assets.
frozen_forecast.expected_path: A tentative net downside bias over seven days, potentially interrupted by rebounds. The main concern is that negative settled demand and shrinking liquidity limit the durability of the current daily repair. This is not a confirmed downtrend, and neither the timing nor magnitude of a decline is supported.
falsification_conditions: Sustained BTC and ETH advances accompanied by persistent ETH/BTC strength and broader relative participation would materially weaken the downside forecast.
Repeated improvement in settled BTC and ETH ETF flows together with stabilization or expansion of stablecoin supply would weaken the adverse demand-and-liquidity premise.
Durable price resilience despite continuing measured flow headwinds would challenge the assumption that those headwinds dominate this horizon.
missing_evidence: A subsequent sequence of settled ETF sessions to distinguish persistent withdrawal from an isolated negative session.
Updated stablecoin supply observations and evidence of actual deployment into risk assets.
Multi-day price structure, persistent ETH/BTC leadership and repeated breadth observations.
Contemporaneous macro changes and reliable catalyst context across the forecast window.
supporting_evidence: The latest settled session recorded BTC ETF outflows of $430.2 million and ETH ETF outflows of $99.9 million, an observed demand headwind rather than evidence of future flows.
Stablecoin supply contracted approximately 2.00% over seven days and 4.61% over thirty days; deployment confirmation is not established.
The 30-day altseason sample had a median alt return of -14.8%, with only 13 of 49 constituents outperforming BTC. This is an adverse participation backdrop, not proof of future losses.

Current relative participation remains limited: only 36 of 100 breadth constituents outperformed BTC and 31 outperformed ETH. The mid-alt proxy median was approximately flat despite its positive mean.
The latest supplied hour weakened in both BTC and ETH rather than confirming continuation of their positive daily returns.
